[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 3: Metagaming Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]3.1[/color] Use each chat channel for its intended purpose. ★
[color=#a4885c]3.2[/color] Characters do not retain any knowledge of events that occurred while they were dead. ★
[color=#a4885c]3.3[/color] Do not use information obtained through meta-communication to perform PvP or other hostile actions against players. ★
[color=#a4885c]3.3A[/color] Meta-communication is permitted only for discussing PvE content. All other information must be communicated through in-game channels. ★
[color=#a4885c]3.4[/color] Discussion about the current round is permitted on the Triad Discord server. However, acting on any information obtained through these discussions is considered metagaming, regardless of the nature of the information. ★
[color=#a4885c]3.5[/color] Do not meta-grudge or meta-friend. Using in-character or out-of-character information to unfairly target, favor, or grant advantages to others is prohibited. ★
